title: Resuscitation Quality Improvement (RQI) mobile simulation station with automated real-time feedback
description: The RQI mobile simulation station is a Laerdal Resusci Anne QCPR adult manikin station used for brief, frequent CPR practice sessions. It provides "real-time audio and visual feedback about performance" and computes overall composite compression and ventilation scores on 0-100% scales, with 75% required to pass, based on depth, rate, release, hand placement, volume, rate, and inspiration time.
requirements: A designated educator certified in BLS and trained in the protocol facilitates sessions; scores of at least 75% are required to progress, with one repeat allowed.
constraints: Sessions practice discrete skills (60 compressions, 12 bag-mask ventilations), not a sequence of CPR; no real-time feedback is given during pretests and posttests.
target_learners: nursing students and health care providers maintaining CPR skills
target_learning_goals: high-quality CPR compressions and ventilations meeting AHA standards
examples: In this study each RQI session included a pretest, demonstration videos, laminated card review, feedback-guided practice, a rest period, and a posttest.
